AssetDeclaration.doc: Root level element for all asset declarations

attributes.name: Radius
attributes.doc: The radius of the body of the capsule and of the end caps.

attributes.name: HalfLength
attributes.doc:
The half-length from the center of the capsule to the beginning of the cap.
              The total length of the capsule is 2*HalfLength + 2*Radius.

attributes.name: EdgeRadius
attributes.doc:
The optional "fatness" of the box. If specified, an extra cushion with this width is
			  added around all sides of the box.

attributes.name: EdgeRadius
attributes.doc:
The optional "fatness" of the box. If specified, an extra cushion with this width is
			  added around all sides of the box.

attributes.name: EdgeRadius
attributes.doc:
The optional "fatness" of the triangle. If specified, an extra cushion with this width
			  is added around all sides of the box.

attributes.name: Mass
attributes.doc:
The mass of the volume. Precision is not necessary, but with intercolliding objects
		  relative masses become important.

attributes.name: Bounciness
attributes.doc:
The coefficient of restitution for the object. Higher percentages cause the object to lose
		  less energy during a collision.

attributes.name: Spinniness
attributes.doc:
A magnitude of extra angular momentum to be randomly added to objects during flinging.
		  This is in addition to the base angular momentum generated by the fling itself.

attributes.name: StaticFriction
attributes.doc:
The coefficient of static friction. Higher values will cause objects which are in resting
		  contact to resist sliding.

attributes.name: KineticFriction
attributes.doc:
The coefficient of kinetic friction. Higher values will slow down objects which are
		  sliding relative to each other.

attributes.name: AngularDrag
attributes.doc: The coefficient of angular drag. This can be used to resist rolling.

attributes.name: LinearDrag
attributes.doc:
The coefficient of linear drag. This can be used to resist large ballistic trajectories.
		  Large values will look very unrealistic.

attributes.name: ReportContacts
attributes.doc: Specifies that contacts involving this object, as either body, should be reported.

attributes.name: Delay
attributes.doc: The delay, starting with the object's creation, before any motion sapping begins.

attributes.name: FadeTime
attributes.doc:
The period of time, after the delay, over which the object's motion is sapped. Due to
		  mathematic approximation, objects may come to rest well before this time has elapsed.
		  Setting this too low will cause unrealistic sapping.

DynamicsLifetime.doc:
Allows an object's dynamic motion to be sapped and eventually removed after the initial
		creation.  This can decrease computation time, as well as minimizing unrealistic behavior
		caused by extended sliding contact.

attributes.name: SideDamageScalar
attributes.doc:
If a unit takes damage from the side this scalar is applied to the incoming damage in addition
							to the regular DamageScalar.

attributes.name: RearDamageScalar
attributes.doc:
If a unit takes damage from the rear this scalar is applied to the incoming damage in addition
							to the regular DamageScalar.

attributes.name: ForbiddenConditions
attributes.default: PREATTACK_A FIRING_A FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_A RELOADING_A USING_WEAPON_A PREATTACK_B FIRING_B FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_B RELOADING_B USING_WEAPON_B PREATTACK_C FIRING_C FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_C RELOADING_C USING_WEAPON_C

attributes.name: ForbiddenConditions
attributes.default: PREATTACK_A FIRING_A FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_A RELOADING_A USING_WEAPON_A PREATTACK_B FIRING_B FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_B RELOADING_B USING_WEAPON_B PREATTACK_C FIRING_C FIRING_OR_PREATTACK_C RELOADING_C USING_WEAPON_C

DynamicsBoneVolumeType.doc: A bone to be dynamically simulated. The supplied volume is interpreted as relative to the object's origin.

children.name: BoneVolumes
children.doc: The set of bones to be assigned volumes. If a bone is not specified, it is tied to its parent bone.

attributes.name: DrawPriority
attributes.doc:
Draw priority of the dynamics object.  Low priority objects get removed first
					from the dynamics world to make room for high priority objects.

attributes.name: LODPriority
attributes.doc:
Specifies how likely dynamics volumes will be created according to the Effects
					LOD setting. If the LODPriority is set to more than the Options setting, we may cull
					some volumes. No culling by default.

attributes.name: Explodiness
attributes.doc:
Specifies how much bones are exploded outwards from the origin of the object.
              A value of 0 specifies that objects are given no radial force.
              A value of 5 is probably kind of TOO explodey.

attributes.name: FlingPerturbation
attributes.doc:
Specifies a magnitude for a random vector applied to each bone in an object.
              A value of 0 specified that objects are not manually perturbed.

attributes.name: AttributeModifierInCover
attributes.doc: Attribute modifier that is active while the unit is in cover.

attributes.name: CoverScanRange
attributes.doc: Range within unit looks for a cover point.

attributes.name: EndCap
attributes.doc: Object that is used for the bridge end caps.

attributes.name: EndCap2
attributes.doc:
Object that is used for the 'right' bridge end cap. If not
							specified the EndCap object is used for this as well, except
							it is rotated 180 degrees.

attributes.name: EndCapLen
attributes.doc: Length of end caps in world units.

attributes.name: CenterPiece
attributes.doc: Object that is used repeatedly between the end caps.

attributes.name: CenterPieceLen
attributes.doc: Length of center piece in world units.

attributes.name: CenterPieceB
attributes.doc:
Optional 'B' center piece. If present CenterPiece and CenterPieceB are
						used alternatingly.

attributes.name: CenterPieceBLen
attributes.doc: Length of center piece B in world units.

attributes.name: Width
attributes.doc: Width of bridge in world units.

attributes.name: GateHouse
attributes.doc: Object that will be used as gate house.

attributes.name: GateHouse2
attributes.doc:
Object that will be used as gate house at the 'right' end
							of the bridge. If not specified the GateHouse object will
							be used instead, rotated by 180 degrees.

attributes.name: DamageNeighborSegementsAtHealthPercent
attributes.doc:
When bridge segments get damaged, they can damage their neighboring
							segments.  This percentage is the threshold for a particular segment
							before its damage carries to adjacent segments.  Adjacent segments
							have their health set to this level when this event is triggered.

BridgeBuilderModuleData.doc:
This module provides basic information needed for a logical bridge to create actual bridge objects.
			The bridge builder object is similar to the horde brain in nature in that it does not exist as
			a visual object but rather as a container grouping together all the logical subobjects.

HashCode.doc: Type to represent 8 digit hexadecimal values

AssetReference.doc: Type for internal references to other declared assets

WeakReference.doc: Type for internal references to other declared assets that need to be post-fixed due to ciruclar dependencies

Poid.doc: "Pipeline Object Id", can be used as an identifier for any complexType in the pipeline

FileReference.doc: Type for external references to stand-alone files

DataBlob.doc: Pulls in data from external references to stand-alone files,

DynamicsContactTag.doc:
Specifies a tag to be used to identify the object for purposes of sound generation.
				When a contact occurs, the two objects' contact tags are available to be read.
